name: Altru Health System Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the health system and see health jobs up close. You get an orientation and on-the-job experience.
who_can_apply: School year: students who have started 10th grade or are at least 16. Summer: students at least 14.
duration: At least one shift a week, 2 to 4 hours, for at least one semester.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Junior Application. Contact Chasity Drees. Chasity Drees is the Volunteer Coordinator. Email cdrees@altru.org. Or call 701.780.5125.
notes: The page does not mention shots or background checks. Ask the coordinator what is needed before you start.
